description: This file serves as the root layout component for the Remix-based frontend of the Student Entrance Test Platform. It defines meta tags, links to external stylesheets, loader functions for initial data fetching, and the main app structure including header, toast notifications, main outlet, and footer.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines the page's meta tags, including title and description.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Provides external stylesheet and font links for the page.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches user session data and flash messages to initialize page state.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: React component providing the HTML structure and including metadata, links, header, and footer.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that renders the application layout, header, notifications, and outlet for nested routes.
